patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with high-contrast dark backgrounds and light typography, often featuring immersive photography or product imagery.
Prominent, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual anchors against dark backgrounds.
A dominant dark mode aesthetic (deep blues, black) is consistently used, contrasted with white text and a single vibrant orange/red accent color for CTAs and highlights.

Background images in multiple sections (e.g., 'ONE PHILOSOPHY', 'Our Award-Winning Lineup', 'ALWAYS CHALLENGING. NEVER BORING.') are fixed or parallax as foreground content scrolls over them, creating a layered depth effect.
The navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid dark background with white text and a slightly more compact form factor after scrolling past the initial hero section.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling library (like locomotive-scroll) to enhance user experience and enable sophisticated scroll-triggered animations. This includes parallax effects where background images move at a different rate than foreground content, creating a sense of depth and visual interest as the user scrolls.

A sticky header is implemented that starts as a transparent overlay on the hero section. Upon scrolling past the hero, it transitions to a solid dark background with white text and a slightly reduced height, maintaining navigation visibility.

Sections are designed as full-bleed containers, often utilizing solid dark colors or large, immersive background images. Content within these sections is typically centered or aligned to a clear grid, with ample padding to create an airy, premium feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by highly legible, smaller sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., button corners, image frames), avoiding sharp angles or fully rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical and horizontal padding around content blocks and between sections, contributing to a premium and spacious feel.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its sophisticated use of scroll-triggered parallax effects with full-bleed, high-quality imagery, creating an immersive and dynamic visual experience. This, combined with a high-contrast dark aesthetic and bold typography, elevates the brand beyond a typical fitness equipment site.
